name: Nested menus help (Molly)
description: Help mode entries for Molly's Nested menus plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Generated menu bar
entries.text: Molly's menus generated from what it holds: Start (Favourites, Recent, Jump to…), the apps, their pages and every plugin, filed by category with at most 12 rows per level. Right-click the bar for Menu settings or the shared menus.

entries.title: Generated navigation
entries.text: Favourites and recent pages first, then one row per category that slides open; each app opens its own pages under it. Right-click a page to pin it.

entries.title: Jump to…
entries.text: Type a word from an app, page, setting or action and press Enter to open the first match.

entries.title: Menu settings
entries.text: General, Categories, Favourites, Recent and a Preview of the tree, each a collapsible section. Every setting is also a command (menus.set).
